outer_split.target_adaptation_window: study days 1-7 (initial adaptation, excluded from evaluation)

target_history_strictly_prior.mechanism: target history mask uses utime < t; target evaluation events enter history only after they occur; per-prediction-time censoring verified in fold driver

source_history_strictly_prior_relative.mechanism: source rows masked by relative study time < t (relative to each source participant's own study start); applies to every source-derived object

per_t_base_means.mechanism: base = smoothed action/context means recomputed from censored source history at each prediction time t; no full-period groupby reuse

per_t_action_and_context_means.mechanism: recomputed per t from strictly-prior source rows with shrinkage n/(n+10)

personal_residual_strictly_prior.mechanism: personal signal uses only target residuals with utime < t

neighbor_vectors_per_t.mechanism: neighbor representation = action x decision-slot residual means computed from censored source histories at t

co_observed_cells_and_similarity_per_t.mechanism: cosine over co-observed cells built per t from strictly-prior rows only; similarity shrinkage n_common/(n_common+10)

fallback_means_per_t.mechanism: action-slot -> action -> overall fallback chain computed from censored history at t

residual_clipping_percentiles_per_t.mechanism: 5th/95th residual clipping percentiles computed from source history only, at prediction time t (no global percentile cache)

no_full_period_precache.finding: none found; all source-derived statistics are computed inside the per-t prediction loop from censored histories

no_future_target_objects.finding: none accessible at prediction time; masks enforce utime < t

held_out_user_isolation.mechanism: per LOPO fold, target participant excluded from source fitting, neighbor construction, source residuals, source statistics, source fallback, source clipping distribution, source similarity space; only allowed use is target prior history in the Personal baseline

context_features_allowed_only.finding: none of the forbidden fields enter model features

preformal_leakage_report.note: PRECHECK verifies leakage structure over the full cohort via strictly-causal masks (utime < t / relative < t) exercised by synthetic driver tests; model math runs on synthetic fixtures only
